notes: ACCESS: potterybarn.com is Akamai-fronted and 403s some fingerprints, but curl_cffi impersonation got HTTP 200 on every page needed this session (winning profiles rotated: chrome124, safari15_5, safari17_0, safari17_2_ios, edge101; chrome131/edge101 intermittently 403 or time out, so a random-profile retry loop was used). r.jina.ai, the route used in the prior Home-Decor pass, is dead for this workstation (403). robots.txt was fetched FIRST: it disallows EasouSpider entirely, gives Pinterestbot crawl-delay 0.2, and its 'User-agent: *' group names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent; it disallows /account/, /checkout/, /shoppingcart/, /services/, /shop_g/, /shop_r/, /products_g/, /products_r/, /personalization/, */minipip, */quicklook, /*N= and '/shop/*+*+*' faceted URLs. Every URL emitted is a plain /shop/bath/<node>/ path, so none is disallowed, and no Crawl-delay applies to '*'. probe.py's 2s/host pacing was used. TREE: taken from Pottery Barn's OWN mega-menu payload, https://www.potterybarn.com/api/catalog/v1/category/categorytree/shop/data.json (926 KB). In that payload type='header' nodes are the grouping rows and type='subcat' nodes the leaves; entries carrying secret=true are hidden from the rendered navigation. That mapping was VERIFIED against the live page: the flyout actually rendered on https://www.potterybarn.com/shop/bath/ was scraped and contains exactly the non-secret nodes (31 /shop/bath/ links) - Towels & Linens, Bath Furniture, Mirrors & Medicine Cabinets, Bath Lighting, Bath Hardware, Accessories, In-Stock Bath, Bestselling Bath, Collaborations, Sale - and no secret ones. Cross-checked against the shop sitemap https://www.potterybarn.com/netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (795 URLs) - every link emitted appears there verbatim - and against constructor.io's group tree for group_id=bath (47 child groups, every recorded leaf present with parents=['all','bath'] and children=[], confirming the taxonomy is two levels deep). Each of the six Bath headers was fetched: /shop/bath/pb-bath-furniture/, /shop/bath/pb-mirrors-medicine-cabinets/, /shop/bath/shop-all-bath-accessories/ all resolve to their 'All ...' View-All page and their own group ids return total_num_results=0 in the site's product engine - i.e. they are navigation-only. They are therefore emitted as grouping rows with blank qty and blank link (rule 24), and the 'All ...' destinations are never recorded (rule 25). Vanity Mirrors and Medicine Cabinets are marked secret in the flyout but are real, sitemap-listed, product-bearing child listings of the Mirrors & Medicine Cabinets header, so they - not the header's View-All page - are the recorded leaves. QTY: Pottery Barn's PLP is client-rendered (the served HTML carries the H1 and breadcrumb but no product total), so every number is response.total_num_results from the storefront's OWN product API, https://ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<slug>?key=key_w3v8XC1kGR9REv46 - the key read live out of the PLP's __INITIAL_STATE__, where constructor.abTestConfig.variant='treatmentSearchEngineConstructor' and enabled=true. VERIFICATION - three independent checks. (1) SOURCE CHAIN, read out of the live WSI storefront bundle dist/shop.cd506c32.js (the same bundle serves PB/PK/PT/WE/WS - it declares POTTERY_BRANDS=['PB','PK','PT']): it assigns 'v.response.numFound = e.response.total_num_results' from this exact browse call, defines productCount() as '(state.shop.cat.response.numFound) || 0', and builds productCountMessage() from productCount + productCountDisplayConfig.displayText; the PB PLP's own __INITIAL_STATE__ sets productCountDisplay={displayText:'Items', isEnabled:true, viewAllProductsJumpLink.enabled={desktop:true,mobile:true}}. So total_num_results IS the number Pottery Barn prints in its 'N Items' / 'View N Items' header. (2) ENUMERATION TO EXHAUSTION on five categories of differing size - bathroom-vanities, bath-storage, towel-ring, cabinet-hardware, bath-accessory-countertop, switch-plates, bathtubs, medicine-cabinets were paged out at 100 results/page and unique product ids counted: 191/191, 73/73, 65/65, 51/51, 27/27, 12/12, 3/3, 13/13 - exact matches. (3) IDENTITY: every recorded leaf URL was fetched and its server-rendered H1 and __INITIAL_STATE__ categoryNames confirmed to be the node requested (e.g. /shop/bath/bath-faucets/ -> H1 'Bathroom Faucets', categoryNames ["Bath","Bathroom Faucets"]; /shop/bath/cabinet-hardware/ -> H1 'Cabinet Knobs & Pulls'). Counts discriminate per category (3 to 191) and no filter/store/zip pre_filter_expression was attached to any request.
